subject: Dear group, how to draw covariate-specific ROC curve? example plot attached.

messages.author: 2a6b8d41aef389ef
messages.subject: Dear group, how to draw covariate-specific ROC curve? example plot attached.
parts:
Dear group

I read a article about 'covariate-speific ROC curve':(below article, figure 5)
http://www.stata-journal.com/sjpdf.html?articlenum=st0155

I think author did not stratify the age group(below 30, 30~40, 40~50), but how could authors specificity the AUC function according to certain Age(months) level?
 Can I draw age-specific-ROC curves without stratification of Age group?

Thank you very much.

Best regards. 
Jin-Ha Yoon
